en.text: My heart is steadfast, God. will sing and I will make music with my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，我心坚定； 要唱诗歌颂！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，我心堅定； 要唱詩歌頌！

en.text: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我要在万民中称谢你，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我要在萬民中稱謝你，

en.text: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，你的慈爱大过诸天；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，你的慈愛大過諸天；

en.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! your glory be over all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，願你崇高過於諸天！

en.text: That your beloved may be delivered, with your right hand, and answer us.

zhSimplified.text: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们，

zhTraditional.text: 求你應允我們，用右手拯救我們，

en.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

zhSimplified.text: 神已经指着他的圣洁说： ， 。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝已經指着他的聖潔說： ， 。

en.text: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. also is my helmet. is my scepter.

zhSimplified.text: 是我的； 是我的； 是护卫我头的； 是我的杖；

zhTraditional.text: 是我的； 是我的； 是護衛我頭的； 是我的杖；

en.text: Moab is my wash pot. will toss my sandal on Edom. will shout over Philistia.”

zhSimplified.text: 是我的沐浴盆； 抛鞋； 呼喊。

zhTraditional.text: 是我的沐浴盆； 拋鞋； 呼喊。

en.text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? will lead me to Edom?

zhSimplified.text: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 地？

zhTraditional.text: 誰能領我進堅固城？ 地？

en.text: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你不是丟棄了我們嗎？

en.text: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

zhSimplified.text: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人，

zhTraditional.text: 求你幫助我們攻擊敵人，

en.text: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 我们倚靠 神才得施展大能，

zhTraditional.text: 我們倚靠上帝才得施展大能，
